spots.name: San Nicolas Island
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 272 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L109505.

spots.name: Begg Rock
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 4 m (13 ft).
